_comment: MultiCaRe release of the case library (reticle/library/cases.py): the files it reads (bytes, MD5 from the Zenodo record), the chunking of case narratives, the figure view size, and articles left out because their upstream case records are wrong or unusable as one human case.

excluded_articles.PMC6310926: several non-human (veterinary) cases in one record
excluded_articles.PMC10159280: the case text gives conflicting patient sex
excluded_articles.PMC8170123: the case text gives a conflicting age and timeline
excluded_articles.PMC9465572: the case text contains an implausible expansion
excluded_articles.PMC10412926: one patient split into two case records
excluded_articles.PMC10793718: case boundary error: treatment text of another patient
excluded_articles.PMC11750508: the case text gives conflicting laboratory results
excluded_articles.PMC8260848: two patients in one case text
